verdict.rationale: Yubico publishes APIs (the YubiCloud OTP validation API and the YubiEnterprise REST API), so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows the OTP reference is a prose specification whose pages "carry no runner". No machine-readable OpenAPI spec exists, and the YubiEnterprise apidocs page is verified only by its title, with nothing showing it is interactive or has runnable examples. The demo.yubico.com site is a browser demo for registering and testing keys, not an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
